entities.name: Mycosynth
entities.description: A metallic fungal organism born of Phyrexian oil corruption of Mirrodin that turns metal into flesh and vice versa.

entities.name: Phyrexian oil
entities.description: Corrupting substance that created the mycosynth.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Initially controlled the mycosynth though he disliked it; died c. 4405 AR.

entities.name: Slobad
entities.description: Captive whose tinkering Memnarch used to replace the lattice.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: Her spark was what Memnarch sought with memnite pillars.

entities.name: Mycosynth Lattice
entities.description: Lattice of mycosynth towers in Mirrodin's Core, torn down by Memnarch.

entities.name: Mycosynth Gardens
entities.description: The former core of Mirrodin where fungi grow unrestricted under New Phyrexia.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: Plane Mirrodin became, spawned by the mycosynth.

entities.name: Vedalken
entities.description: Theorized that spores made metal grow in the womb.

events.summary: Mycosynth spores spread across Mirrodin, changing metal to flesh and vice versa.
events.quote: Mycosynth was released in spores throughout the plane

events.summary: Memnarch tears down the Mycosynth Lattice and uses captive Slobad to replace it with memnite pillars to obtain Glissa's spark.
events.quote: he decided to tear the lattice down and use the captive Slobad 's tinkering abilities

events.summary: On Memnarch's death c. 4405 AR the mycosynth spreads out of control, turning Mirrans into Phyrexians.
events.quote: Upon Memnarch's death in c. 4405 AR, the remaining mycosynth spread out of control

events.summary: Under New Phyrexia the former core becomes the Mycosynth Gardens.
events.quote: the former core of Mirrodin became the Mycosynth Gardens

relations.note: initially controlled it but strongly disliked it
relations.quote: The Mycosynth was initially controlled by Memnarch , although he strongly disliked it.
